title: Myriad Aggregation
text: Start Myriad Aggregation in a Miniature World Framework with wood and dirt, or an Analysis Crystal and Genesis Particles.

The world develops through the Overworld, Nether and End. After its final scene, a Nether Star or Encapsulated Stable Spacetime Aggregate collapses it into one Omni Microcore. Frame projections and JEI show each stage's materials.
Dimension crossings and the final collapse clear leftover materials. The microcore remains inside until taken; only then does the frame reset.
